title: Learn It Once
look: Session board: developers, a personal constitution, rule packs, a share preview, the dōjō pipeline and the scope stack on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion, jade for what the team keeps. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: Four times
scenes.desc: Four developers teach their assistants the same lesson, separately.

scenes.name: Your rules
scenes.desc: Even solo you have a constitution; adopt proven rule packs into it.

scenes.name: Share on your terms
scenes.desc: A rule that works is offered to the dōjō: previewed, anonymised, confirmed.

scenes.name: The team decides
scenes.desc: Contributions accumulate, maintainers triage and approve, then it is distributed.

scenes.name: Upgrades
scenes.desc: It reaches every member as an upgrade they can apply, mute or pin.

scenes.name: Wherever you code
scenes.desc: Rules resolve across dōjō, workspace and repository; preview any project's rules before the first commit.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: learn it once, and the team keeps it.
